description: Vogelbuurt-Noord 1921-28 two-storey rows under a tiled roof (Flamingostraat, Pelikaanstraat, Pluvierplein, Meeuwenplein, Kalkoenstraat): 6.3-6.6 m brick fronts of a 3.1 m ground storey and a 3.3 m upper storey under a grey cornice slab at 6.4 m; each front has a wide white-framed window (2.7 m, three lights) over a ground window and, at the party wall, a narrow upper window over the paired double door; flat-roofed dormers over the wide windows in the row, and crow-stepped gables on the block ends

match.note: BAG 1921-28, 3DBAG eaves 6.8-7.8 m (the roof's own height; the strip cornice is at 6.4 m), bouwlagen 3; widths 6.3-6.6 m; no skyline crown rules: on the 2018-2025 strips the sky band reads cloud edges and neighbouring roofs as gables (Kalkoenstraat 14, 16), so the type draws its first crown (flat-dormer) and the block-end gables are pinned from the sheets (review-crowns)

flat-dormer.note: Flamingostraat 4-10 (2020-06-02): a flat-roofed white dormer 2.4 m wide, 6.3-7.3 m, over the wide window

step-gable.note: Flamingostraat 3 and 15: a pointed brick gable (fine toothed raking edge, drawn plain) 6.2 m over the 6.4 m cornice (apex 12.6 m) with one two-light window at 6.7-8.3 m

door-left.note: a dark green double door pair spanning the party wall, 0.9 m per front, with a transom; the neighbour mirrors it

rhythm.bays: narrow window over the door, wide window
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: door + wide window | 1: narrow + wide
rhythm.symmetry: mirror pairs about the party wall
rhythm.groundFloor: double doors paired across the party wall
rhythm.roofline: grey cornice slab; a flat dormer over the wide window, a crow-stepped gable on block ends

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2020-06-02, 40 px/m, 1 m grid: pands 6.3 m; ground window head 2.1 m sill 0.5 m, wide ground window 2.7 m; upper wide window sill 3.16 m head 5.19 m 2.7 m wide, narrow window 0.95 m, same sill and head; double door 0-2.1 m pair across the party wall; cornice slab 6.3-6.5 m; flat dormer 6.3-7.3 m, 2.4 m wide, three lights; gable apex 12.6 m, one 1.7 m window at 6.7-8.3 m

schemaLimits: the grey brick of Flamingostraat (lighter, grey-yellow) against the red-brown of Pelikaanstraat is one palette here
the crow-step teeth along the raking edge
the white window sills and the lintel soldier courses
notes: Palette: brick #7d5446 is the dark-brown family of Pelikaan/Pluvier strips; Flamingostraat photographs grey-yellow; use a palette pin per row where the photo says so.
